candidate_relations.reason: The histology and immunoprofile (α-SMA+, desmin+, vimentin+, EBV-) specifically support leiomyosarcoma rather than generic spindle cell sarcoma. C001 names the broader family without the required smooth-muscle differentiation subtype.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Spindle cell sarcoma is the parent category; leiomyosarcoma is the specific subtype confirmed by smooth muscle markers (SMA, desmin, vimentin positivity)

case_quality_flags: Immunohistochemical profile (SMA, desmin, vimentin positive; EBV negative) is pathognomonic for leiomyosarcoma and distinguishes it from other spindle cell sarcomas
